tags: 大衛帳幕的榮耀 10 主祢是我們的太陽
meta.author:
詞 鄭孆薇、楊麗珊
曲 鄭孆薇

lines.a: 我來到祢寶座 獻上我的禱告
lines.b: I come before Your throne and offer my prayers

lines.a: 在這寧靜時刻我聽見祢的聲音
lines.b: I can hear Your voice in this quiet moment

lines.a: 因為祢的愛 已經找到了我
lines.b: Because Your love has found me

lines.a: 使我配得走進祢的同在裡
lines.b: So that I am worthy to be in Your presence

lines.a: 在這安靜時刻 祢聆聽我呼求
lines.b: You listen to my cry in this quiet moment

lines.a: 享受在祢的榮耀聖潔中
lines.b: I am soaking in Your glory and holiness

lines.a: 求祢仰起臉 來光照我的心
lines.b: Lord please lift up Your face and light up my heart

lines.a: 祢使我心 充滿了快樂
lines.b: You satisft my heart with joy

lines.a: 主啊祢是 我全然信靠
lines.b: Lord I put my faith in You
My Lord Jehovah makes me dwell in peace
My Lord Jehovah makes me dwell in peace
